Energy Conversion

Lucas Bishop (Marvel Comics) using accumulated kinetic energy from falling to convert it into other forms of energy to slow his fall.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb and convert energy.

The power to absorb energy and convert into another form of energy. Sub-power of Energy Manipulation, Energy Absorption and Transmutation. Not to be confused with Energy Emulation.

Also Called[]

  • Energy Converter
  • Transduction

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb, convert, and redirect one form of energy into another. By acting as a living energy transducer, they are capable of transforming sound into light, kinetic force into heat, electricity into magnetism, heat into plasma, and countless other forms of energetic equivalence. This allows them to weaponize absorbed energy, neutralize attacks by converting them into harmless forms, or repurpose surrounding energy sources for offense, defense, mobility, or support. The user may store converted energy within themselves, release it immediately, or channel it into constructs, beams, fields, or physical augmentation.

Limitations[]

  • May be limited to how much one can absorb/convert.
  • May only be limited to converting and generating to one type of energy.
